prompts.tank: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready transparent 2D cutout rig kit for a humorous top-down cartoon farm action game. ONE consistent character in THREE views in a precise THREE ROWS x THREE COLUMNS layout. Row 1 full left profile (beak points LEFT), row 2 directly front facing, row 3 directly rear facing. Every row: column 1 complete torso including head, wings tucked at sides and tail, but NO LEGS OR FEET; column 2 detached LEFT leg/foot with short shin; column 3 detached RIGHT leg/foot with short shin. Nine separated cutout parts, no overlap between parts, generous transparent gaps; all parts fully inside their grid cell. Same character design and size across views. Broad simple readable shapes, restrained hand-painted shading, warm upper-left light, dark subtle outlines, friendly humorous exaggerated proportions matching chunky cartoon rooster mascots. True transparent background, no checker pattern, no ground, no shadows, no effects, no text, no panel grid, no weapons, no other characters. The torso must occupy most of its cell without crossing boundaries. Feet orange, three chunky toes. Make all torso bottoms rounded with visible leg sockets so feet can attach.  Character: a hilariously self-important HEAVY ARMORED TURKEY, squat and broad, walnut-brown plumage, ivory cheek feathers, a big red snood dangling from a short yellow beak, small stern funny eyes, broad bronze and dark iron shoulder pads, an upside-down battered cooking pot as helmet with a little side handle, thick leather belt with one brass buckle, wide short fan-shaped turkey tail rooted in the rump. No rooster comb. Head moderately sized, big bulky belly and round shoulders. Silhouette wide and sturdy, armor large simple pieces, no intricate engravings. Rear view shows clear short broad turkey tail fan and pot helmet. Body width roughly 90 percent of torso cell, all edges safe.
